        basename = basename[:-3]
    else:
        print(f"Unexpected file extension: {file_path}")
        all_match = False
        continue
    # Replace underscores with spaces
    expected_title = basename.replace('_', ' ')

    if expected_title not in title_to_note:
        print(f"Missing note for title: {expected_title}")
        all_match = False

        print(f"Content mismatch for {expected_title}")
        all_match = False

        print(f"OK: {expected_title}")
